notes: A is an offline matched-risk policy proxy, not the historical executable.
A promotes eligible holds until one share actually fills in the US session.
All A/B/C use ordinary 1% risk; historical daily-minimum 5% override is omitted.
B disables the minimum objective; zero buys is normal no_trade.
C adds simultaneous sell-score entry veto and completed-bar general-signal deduplication.
Completed bars must have explicit timezone-aware close timestamps.
Protective exits run from valid marks before general-signal deduplication.
All legacy exit numbers, quantity, allocation and cost assumptions are shared.
No production GUI settings, held-position policy or executable is changed.
